description.content: Official YouTube channel of Shiromani Gurdwara Parbandhak Committee (SGPC), Sri Amritsar. This channel is dedicated to the live broadcast of Gurbani Kirtan (traditional singing of Holy Sikh verses) from Sachkhand Sri Harmandir Sahib Sri Darbar Sahib, Sri Amritsar, the central Sikh shrine situated in Punjab, India. The SGPC is the foremost organisation of Sikhs established on November 15, 1920, and it is governed under the provisions of the Sikh Gurdwaras Act of 1925 in India. The SGPC is responsible for the management of historical Gurdwara Sahibs (Sikh shrines) in India, and it also deals with concerns of the Sikh community in India and across the globe.
